name: folio-news
description: Folio News - a news reader with bookmarks, likes, notes and AI summaries

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,scraper -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev:scraper"
scripts.setup:scraper: cd scraper && python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
